exposure: international clinical practice guidelines (American College of Chest Physicians, Royal College of Obstetricians and Gynaecologists, Society of Obstetricians and Gynaecologists of Canada, Society of Obstetric Medicine of Australia and New Zealand)
obstetric risk factors (caesarean birth, maternal age >35 years, BMI >30 kg/m², instrumental birth)
outcome: proportion of women qualifying for postpartum low molecular weight heparin (LMWH) prophylaxis
identification of common risk factors for LMWH recommendation
cohort: 338 women from one regional and two tertiary maternity hospitals in New South Wales, Australia were included in the analysis.
finding: There are considerable differences in the rates of women who would qualify for postpartum pharmacological venous thromboembolism prophylaxis when recommendations from different international guidelines are applied.
mod_finding: Caesarean birth and instrumental birth were identified among the most common risk factors for women qualifying for postpartum LMWH prophylaxis.
